defmodule AuthLib.TokenVerifier do
  @moduledoc "Async token verification with pluggable strategy resolution"

  @allowed_strategies MapSet.new([
    "AuthLib.Strategy.HMAC",
    "AuthLib.Strategy.RSA",
    "AuthLib.Strategy.ECDSA"
  ])

  def verify_token_async(token, opts \\ []) do
    task = Task.async(fn ->
      with {:ok, header} <- decode_header(token),
           {:ok, strategy_mod} <- resolve_strategy(header, opts),
           {:ok, claims} <- apply_verification(strategy_mod, token, opts) do
        {:ok, claims}
      end
    end)

    case Task.await(task, opts[:timeout] || 5000) do
      {:ok, claims} -> {:ok, claims}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp decode_header(token) do
    case String.split(token, ".") do
      [header_b64 | _rest] ->
        with {:ok, json} <- Base.url_decode64(header_b64, padding: false),
             {:ok, header} <- Jason.decode(json) do
          {:ok, header}
        else
          _ -> {:error, :invalid_header}
        end
      _ -> {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_strategy(header, _opts) do
    strategy_name = determine_strategy_name(header)
    validate_and_load(strategy_name)
  end

  defp determine_strategy_name(header) do
    cond do
      header["alg"] in ["HS256", "HS384", "HS512"] ->
        "AuthLib.Strategy.HMAC"
      header["alg"] in ["RS256", "RS384", "RS512"] ->
        "AuthLib.Strategy.RSA"
      header["alg"] in ["ES256", "ES384", "ES512"] ->
        "AuthLib.Strategy.ECDSA"
      true ->
        "AuthLib.Strategy.HMAC"
    end
  end

  defp validate_and_load(strategy_name) do
    if MapSet.member?(@allowed_strategies, strategy_name) do
      mod = String.to_existing_atom("Elixir." <> strategy_name)
      {:ok, mod}
    else
      {:error, :unknown_strategy}
    end
  end

  defp apply_verification(strategy_mod, token, opts) do
    if function_exported?(strategy_mod, :verify, 2) do
      strategy_mod.verify(token, opts)
    else
      {:error, :strategy_not_implemented}
    end
  end
end

defmodule AuthLib.SessionManager do
  @moduledoc "Manages authenticated sessions with async token refresh"

  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def authenticate(token, conn_opts \\ []) do
    safe_opts = Keyword.take(conn_opts, [:timeout])
    AuthLib.TokenVerifier.verify_token_async(token, safe_opts)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts), do: {:ok, %{sessions: %{}, opts: opts}}
end
